name: Elephant
label: Elephant head
review: Reference-based fold sequence; shaping angles are illustrative.
titles: Bring the left edge to centre
Bring the right edge to centre
descriptions: Bring the top corner to the bottom corner and align the edges.
Bring the right corner to the left. Press the centre crease lightly.
Open that fold. Keep the first diagonal folded; the centre mark helps place the ears.
Bring the lower-left edge to centre; keep the bottom point still.
Match the right fold, bringing both edges together.
Fold the left flap outward, with its lower edge horizontal.
Fold the right flap outward to match the left ear.
Tuck the outer left corner inward.
Tuck the matching right corner inward.
Turn the entire model over without adding a crease. Keep all the layers together.
Raise the long triangle at the ears’ base.
Fold down, leaving a narrow strip.
Fold the small tip downward once more.
Ease the last pleat open without flattening its crease.
Extend the middle pleat, keeping the paper gently zigzagged.
Ease open the next pleat so the trunk projects in three dimensions.
Lower the trunk with its accordion shape intact.
